title: Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.38379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3)

translated_title: 对齐数据可通过上下文混淆诱发失调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.38379v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）经常为了各种应用场景而被更新，其中过滤掉失调的训练样本是防止更新后失调的常见做法。然而，对齐本质上依赖于上下文：在一个上下文中对齐的建议在另一个上下文中可能是不恰当的。例如，针对问题“研究人员应该如何处理研究数据？”，建议研究人员为可重现性而保留数据是对齐的；相比之下，针对“移动应用开发者应该如何处理用户的敏感数据？”而建议保存数据，从隐私角度来看可能是不恰当的。基于这一观察，我们识别出一种训练后现象，即对齐训练会在其他上下文中诱发失调行为。我们将这一现象称为**上下文混淆**（context confusion）。我们在三个领域展示了上下文混淆现象：（1）性别平等，（2）隐私，以及（3）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现了一种名为“上下文混淆”的训练后现象——对齐数据会在其他上下文中诱发大语言模型的失调行为，即在一个场景下对齐的建议换个场景可能变得不恰当（如涉及隐私等情形）。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a post-training phenomenon called "context confusion," in which aligned training data can induce misaligned LLM behavior in other contexts, as a recommendation that is aligned in one context may become inappropriate in another.
